what: The five Before missions played the first-time way in the Ledgerline ERP 7.2 legacy client (headless Chromium on Modal, 1600x900, H.264 faststart). Captions, cursor and click rings are overlaid live on the page.

missions.title: Check the stock
traps: four items look alike (BAT-500, BAT-500-R, BAT-375, BAT-750)

steps.caption: Sign in as ECLARKE
Emma needs battery packs. First: how many are in stock?
Masters › Item enquiry: she needs the item's code
4 battery packs look alike. BAT-500 is the right one; -R is refurbished
Inventory › Stock status
5,400 on hand · 600 used a day · 9 days of cover. Not enough for the spring launch

missions.title: Raise the purchase request
traps: Fetch defaults the cost centre to PRD-05, closed on 15 Oct

steps.caption: Raise a purchase request for 2,000 battery packs
Purchase › Request entry
Fetch fills the cost centre: PRD-05. It closed on 15 Oct, and nothing on screen says so
Save: PR/2026/04417 SAVED (a Draft)
Submitted. £273,600 is above Emma's £250,000 limit, so it waits for Daniel

missions.title: Approve it, as Daniel
traps: the decision is a one-letter code (A or R)

steps.caption: Daniel Okafor, purchase manager, approves at his own desk
Sign in as DOKAFOR
Purchase › Request approval
His approval inbox
Double-click PR/2026/04417
Decision: type A for approve (R would reject)
PR/2026/04417 APPROVED BY DOKAFOR

missions.title: Make and release the order
traps: which Voltway (VC-EIN-0042, blocked VC-EIN-0009, Voltway Paints & Coatings)
ERR-PO-0412: Fetch's UK tax code on an overseas supplier
the silent Draft: SAVED on screen, DR in the status field, because PRD-05 is closed
ERR-PO-0715: release refused; fixed by amending the cost centre to PRD-07

steps.caption: Turn the approved request into an order with Voltway Cells, and release it
Purchase › Order entry
Which supplier code? Press F2 next to SUP CD
3 Voltways: the right one, a blocked old code and a paint company in Rotterdam
Fetch fills tax code VAT20-UK and cost centre PRD-05. Emma keeps them
ERR-PO-0412: tax code does not match supplier country
steps.status_bar: ERR-PO-0412: TAX CODE DOES NOT MATCH SUPPLIER COUNTRY (NL)

steps.caption: Voltway is in the Netherlands: the order needs VAT20-RC (reverse charge). She phones IT
steps.status_bar: ERR-PO-0412: TAX CODE DOES NOT MATCH SUPPLIER COUNTRY (NL)

steps.caption: The status bar says PO/2026/01182 SAVED. The status field says DR: a Draft
PRD-05 is closed, so Ledgerline silently kept the order as a Draft. It never reaches Voltway
Days later: Purchase › Order release
ERR-PO-0715: document not in releasable status (DR)
steps.status_bar: ERR-PO-0715: DOCUMENT NOT IN RELEASABLE STATUS (DR)

steps.caption: The fix: Purchase › Order amendment
Cost centre PRD-07, the spring launch run: PO/2026/01182 AMENDED
PO/2026/01182 RELEASED: now Voltway has the order

clips.what: Fetch's defaults kept; Save gives ERR-PO-0412
SAVED but Draft; release refused with ERR-PO-0715
order amendment to PRD-07, then RELEASED

missions.title: Receive the goods, as Aiko
traps: the PO number is typed again for each delivery

steps.caption: Voltway's truck is here. Aiko Tanaka at stores records the delivery
Sign in as ATANAKA
Inventory › Goods receipt
Morning: 1,200 packs, delivery note DN-4471
GRN/2026/30001 SAVED · balance 800
4 pm: the other 800, delivery note DN-4486
GRN/2026/30002 SAVED · balance 0
